cohort: 15 cases of pulmonary tuberculosis during pregnancy and 191 low-risk pregnancies
finding: Pulmonary tuberculosis during pregnancy was associated with increased perinatal morbidity, lower birth weight, poorer APGAR scores, and higher rates of respiratory distress.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean delivery was similar between women with and without pulmonary tuberculosis.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2308.6 g in the pulmonary tuberculosis group and 2707.56 g in the control group
